# Public reporting examples, pinned without modification

Source: `ccusage/ccusage`, tag `v20.0.20`, commit `bd7f89b469aee5635fb2e6722dd6d70f2d113ac1`.

- [claude.jsonl original](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/bd7f89b469aee5635fb2e6722dd6d70f2d113ac1/apps/ccusage/test/fixtures/claude/projects/project-alpha/session-alpha/chat.jsonl)
- [codex.jsonl original](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/bd7f89b469aee5635fb2e6722dd6d70f2d113ac1/apps/ccusage/test/fixtures/codex/sessions/project-alpha/session-alpha.jsonl)

The adjacent MIT LICENSE belongs to the upstream project. These are public fictional reporting fixtures, not verified personal transcripts. `public_shapes.rs` checks the unchanged fixtures' refusal/skip behavior and explicitly adds an assistant type only in memory to compare Claude count semantics. It does not invent missing Codex session identity, repair inconsistent totals or adopt upstream prices. See the U1 desktop validation note for the compatibility limit.
